text:
Claire (CS): kicking off Fairwind day0 onboarding sync — dropping a short ops checklist and tagging infra.
Arun (CSM): sending their infra contact + calendar invite.
Claire (CS): compact checklist: 1) VPC peering + route table updates 2) cross-account IAM role + session duration 3) KMS grants and rotation proof 4) CloudTrail -> S3 forwarding (with external bucket policy) 5) NAT sizing for spike traffic
Leo (Eng): quick q — do we have their VPC CIDR and peer account?
Claire (CS): onboarding form has 10.44.0.0/16, peer acct 987654321098; egress will be NAT gw elastic IPs.
Mike (SRE): routing note — add route: 10.44.0.0/16 -> pcx-abc123. Set ephemeral assume-role max session 1h.
Leo (Eng): KMS: ask them to provide key ARN(s). Redwood needs kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey perms for our service role.
Claire (CS): pasted a minimal KMS policy snippet they can apply:

```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodServiceRole"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

Claire (CS): recommended rotation cadence: 90 days by default, can tighten if compliance asks.
Arun (CSM): tagging renewal risk — if audit logs or KMS proofs are delayed, finance runs a 30-day renewal health check and may escalate. Added to the risk tracker.
Mike (SRE): CloudTrail: need CloudTrail enabled, S3 bucket + external policy, prefixed objects with salt. If they want live splunk ingestion confirm HEC token + endpoint.
Leo (Eng): what volume should we assume for token/ingest sizing? impacts NAT throughput and burst headroom.
Claire (CS): Fairwind estimate: ~6GB/day steady, up to 25GB/day during integration.
Mike (SRE): plan: provision NAT with 3x headroom. I'll open infra change requests.
ops-bot: created tickets CS-4023 (NAT capacity) and CS-4024 (CloudTrail forwarding). <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4023>
Leo (Eng): ops playbook add: on S3 put failures check external bucket policy, bucket KMS grants, and CloudTrail region settings.
Claire (CS): next steps: 1) Arun to collect KMS ARN + Splunk HEC token 2) Mike to provision NAT headroom + route updates 3) Leo to add runbook snippets + IAM docs. Sync scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT.
Arun (CSM): looping Fairwind infra channel and emailing their infra lead.
Claire (CS): thanks — react with :thumbsup: when done.
Mike (SRE): :thumbsup:
